prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one standalone dialogue portrait for a gritty low-fantasy RPG, target 74x100 pixels. Substantively redraw the established individual as an adult close-up head, not a crop of the full-body reference.
Input roles: image 1 is ONLY the established identity/costume reference. Images 2-5 (Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore) are STYLE ONLY, never copy their face, age or expression. Adopt their coarse hard-edged pixel clusters and angular adult face planes.
Composition: tall 74:100, a very large head in slight three-quarter view facing viewer-left. Crown near y=4%, chin near y=86%; full hair silhouette, ears and bun where present remain inside with a small transparent margin. Very short neck and NARROW collar strip only in bottom 10%, no bust, no shoulders spreading to canvas edges. Face and hair dominate the canvas. Do not chop hair to enlarge face.
Style: broad connected pixel clusters carve forehead, nose bridge and wings, cheekbones, temples and jaw. Hard rectangular/stepped edges, robust adult bone structure, clear nose and cheek planes. About 24-32 flat muted colors with warm skin and deep brown shadows. No fine texture, no gradients, no airbrush, no antialiasing, no dithering, no noise/speckles, no loose single-pixel hair strands, no soft painted highlights. Hair is 4-6 connected big masses. Small adult eyes, dark iris/lid shapes, at most a tiny muted sclera accent. No big bright whites, no anime/chibi, no generic upward worried eyebrows. Genuinely transparent background. Exactly one portrait, no labels, frame, props, hands or extra objects.
Identity: ELON, PAS-NPC-ELON, a sturdy man in his thirties, ordinary cargo laborer and ordinary patient; a single man, not a fusion or duplication of other patients. Keep broad high forehead and squared broad adult face, short dark brown slightly receding irregular hairline, broad straight nose, heavy upper lids and compact close brown beard/stubble joined around mouth and jaw. Hair is short connected chunks, not strands; beard is simple contiguous shadow masses, not dots. His gaze is level, tired but self-possessed, matter-of-fact rather than pitiful; mostly flat thick brows, closed nearly level firm mouth, a hint of asymmetry. Do not copy Tore's narrow long face or sad raised brows. Skin is weathered warm ochre but not elderly: a single restrained forehead plane, no extra gray hair or deeply corrugated wrinkles. Tiny narrow warm brown laborer's split-collar shirt below a muted slate-gray patient cloth outer edge; no broad shoulders or wrapped scarf bulk. No wound, diagnosis, hospital emblem, military rank, drug, label or new costume.
